landing.headline: Understand your results. Share only what you choose.
landing.lede: Your carrier results stay in your private vault. If you both agree, a private check compares your results and shows only what you share. Nothing else about either of you crosses over.
landing.twoCirclesBody: Each of you is a private circle. Only the overlap you both consent to is ever drawn, and only if there is one.

protect.privateBody: Your partner never sees your results, only the shared finding you both agreed to check.

protect.peopleBody: Any result that needs a conversation goes to a human genetic counselor.
protect.decideBody: We explain. We never tell you what to do. You can withdraw consent at any time.

help.title: Help
help.description: Answers, who does what, and how to reach a person.

carrier: Someone with one changed copy of a gene. Carriers are usually healthy.
recessive: Appears only when a child inherits a changed copy from both parents.
residual: The small chance left after a negative test, because no test finds every carrier.
detection: How often the test finds a carrier who is there.
privateCheck: A comparison that reveals only genes you both carry, and only if you both agree.
related: Partners who are relatives. Sharing a gene change is more likely, so it is counted.

help.contactBody: A genetic counselor can explain your results in Arabic or English.
